dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! Nam, I'm sorry. I broke your cup. I'm so careless!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈsɑːri. aɪ ˈbroʊk jʊr ˈkʌp. aɪm ˈsoʊ ˈkɛrləs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry. It was an old cup.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. ɪt wʌz ən ˈoʊld ˈkʌp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You're very generous. I'll buy you a new one.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈvɛri ˈdʒɛnərəs. aɪl ˈbaɪ juː ə ˈnuː ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Be careful. There's glass on the floor.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! bi ˈkɛrfəl. ðɛrz ˈɡlæs ɑːn ðə ˈflɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm hopeless in the kitchen. My mom says I'm dangerous!
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈhoʊpləs ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən. maɪ ˈmɑːm ˈsɛz aɪm ˈdeɪndʒərəs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You aren't hopeless. You're very helpful in the kitchen!
dialogue.reading: juː ˈɑːrnt ˈhoʊpləs. jʊr ˈvɛri ˈhɛlpfəl ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks, Nam. Oh, is Fah still coming on Sunday?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm. ˈoʊ, ɪz ˈfɑː ˈstɪl ˈkʌmɪŋ ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. She's a bit jealous of you!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ʃiːz ə ˈbɪt ˈdʒɛləs əv juː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Because you live with her big sister, and she doesn't!
dialogue.reading: bɪˈkɔːz juː ˈlɪv wɪð hɜːr ˈbɪɡ ˈsɪstər, ənd ʃiː ˈdʌzənt!
